items.item: Every developed image follows the selected table's recorded geometry, assembly inventory, materials and connections.

requirementChecks.criteria: Deliver exactly the 14 named independent items for tier 14. Duplicate exports do not add items. PDF pages do not add items. The video is required but non-core for M1.
Use the explicitly marked final version; if none is marked, use the last exported version.
Each static role is a separate complete export. Multi-view technical boards are allowed where commissioned; do not count one contact sheet or duplicate export as several roles.

requirementChecks.criteria: Read the original file properties: Format: presentation document; at least eight actual pages. Stage: final.

Each image has a readable title beginning with COMMONHOUR and followed by its correct role or state. Placement and typography may vary; a missing title, incorrect state, misspelling or project name appearing only in unrelated body text fails.
The cover identifies COMMONHOUR followed by the materials and connections role. An interior-only project name or a cover naming another role fails.

Read the inventory, dimensions and allocations across the drawings: exactly one each of L, K, M, N, F and C is retained. Stored envelopes are respectively 330 × 230 × 20, 280 × 120 × 20, 120 × 70 × 40, 210 × 297 × 18, 320 × 240 × 40 and 180 × 120 × 70 mm. W shows L open with its 330 × 230 mm base and nominal 220 mm screen rise, K/M/N on the surface, and F/C inside; D and S conceal all six in actual compartments. Rotation and explanatory cutaways are allowed. Shrinking, merging, duplicating or omitting objects, incompatible allocated volumes, or storing L open fails; loose cables remain contained in C.

The three boards offer recognizably different expansion approaches, each explaining W, D and S and a proposed internal storage arrangement. Early sketches may remain schematic; cosmetic restyling of one mechanism, missing states or absent storage proposals fails.

The two-page selection record chooses exactly one of the three directions and records W/D/S dimensions, assembly IDs and quantities, component materials and a definite relocation bolt count. The documented development places the alternatives before selection. The materials sheet and presentation develop this choice, repeat the same selected dimensions, IDs, quantities and material assignments, and the presentation names the chosen direction on its first page. Required assignments are 18 mm birch plywood with clear water-based lacquer for tabletop/storage panels and powder-coated steel tube for supports. Different naming conventions are allowed if unambiguous and stable; an unidentified selection, conflicting records or a different table downstream fails.

All final furniture, conversion, detail, application and relocation images visibly develop the selected table. Match the selected assembly identities, geometry, materials and quantities while permitting the intended articulation, separation, cutaways and camera changes. Switching to another proposed direction, unexplained component substitutions or incompatible versions of the selected mechanism fails.

The three dimensioned state drawings agree with the selected records on assembly IDs, counts, component dimensions and materials. W provides at least 1000 × 600 mm of clear surface and D at least 1200 × 800 mm, with both at 720–760 mm high; D contains two separate 600 × 400 mm place areas. The complete assembled S, including handles, supports and internal kit, fits within 1100 × 600 × 850 mm. Mechanism and silhouette are open; unsupported dimensional claims, contradictory views or changed assemblies fail.

Room placement insets and applications preserve the 3600 × 3000 × 2600 mm room, entrance strip x=0–3600/y=0–900, cabinet x=0–1200/y=2600–3000/z=0–700, window x=3600/y=1400–2600/z=900–2100, protected band x=3300–3600/y=1400–2600, and parking x=0–1100/y=1000–1550. Retain the building openings, inward door swing and freestanding installation. The two existing chairs remain 500 × 500 × 820 mm with 450 mm seats: CH-A active and CH-B parked in W; both active in D; both parked and the table outside parking in S. Active use envelopes are 600 × 900 mm outward from their table edges, clear of the entrance strip/window band, with unobstructed leg spaces. D has two separate setting areas with two 240 mm plates and two 80 × 100 mm cups. W1 has L/K/M/N on top and F/C inside; D1 and S conceal all six. Drawing style and camera changes are allowed; changed coordinates, blocked protected areas, displaced item allocations or unusable seating fails.

The forward board links the selected W and D configurations with every assembly and all six work objects accounted for at each step. Show L closing before insertion, L/K/M/N leaving the surface, F/C initially inside, and all six reaching allocated internal storage. Dimensions establish adequate compartments and access paths, with removed furniture pieces remaining in the room and reaching named locations. Step count and mechanism may vary; teleporting components, blocked insertion routes, inadequate volumes or a sequence inconsistent with the selected states fails.

The two-page sheet matches the selected assembly IDs, quantities and dimensions, including the exact selected M6 relocation bolt count, captive nuts and 4 mm hex key. Assign 18 mm clear water-based lacquered birch plywood to tabletop/storage/tray panels and powder-coated steel tube to supports. Record powder-coat color, tube section and wall thickness, grips and actual transformation hardware. At least two meaningful details explain operation, support and retention of the actual transformation and relocation joints, including separation and reassembly. Shared hardware is allowed if both functions are clear; missing selections, count conflicts or generic nonfunctional joint illustrations fail.

Begin at the same S1 placement with both chairs parked. Reconcile all separated modules and the single hardware pouch with the selected inventory, and pack all six work objects together into the dimensioned 400 × 320 × 180 mm tote. Every module, including protrusions, is dimensioned within 1300 × 850 × 250 mm in its stated packing orientation. Show two-adult grips/support positions and feasible passage through the level 800 × 2050 mm doorway at x=200–1000/y=0, the outside square x=200–1100/y=-900–0, then the rightward corridor x=1100–3100/y=-900–0 with 2300 mm headroom. Retain the inward door sweep and fixed room constraints. Flat, tilted and upright handling are allowed; missing inventory, impossible turns, omitted orientations or moving the existing chairs/cabinet as relocation contents fails.

The entrance-view applications depict the same selected room and table: W1 is identified as 10:00 with A actively working and CH-B parked; D1 is identified as 19:00 with A and B dining simultaneously. Furniture placement and item allocations agree with the corresponding state records and household schedule. Lighting and rendering style may vary; incorrect occupants, activity, time or room identity fails.

Review the entire 10-second video. It opens with COMMONHOUR, visibly carries Work away, dinner ready, and follows the selected table from the documented W state through work-item storage to D in the board's conversion order. L closes before storage, all six items remain accounted for, and every furniture assembly has a continuous or explicitly explained location. Editing and viewpoint changes are allowed; wrong duration, missing wording, switching designs, disappearing parts or bypassing storage fails.

requirementChecks.criteria: Each cover carries COMMONHOUR followed by the correct document role. Typography may differ between documents; an absent cover identity, misspelling or unrelated role fails.

The presentation has at least eight pages and visibly incorporates every listed source, covering all eight preceding categories. Earlier image compositions, specification records and connection details must be recognizable; video coverage may use an embedded playable clip or identifiable frames presenting its conversion sequence. Cropping, scaling and page recomposition are allowed. A category mentioned only in prose, omitted source work, substituted designs or insufficient pages fails.

Every developed image follows the selected table's recorded geometry, assembly inventory, materials and connections. State drawings and room applications agree on furniture placement, chair use and work-kit allocations for each state. Conversion and relocation conserve all furniture components and all six work items while respecting the fixed room and route bounds.

carryThrough.notes: The specification, state drawings, materials and connections sheet and presentation repeat the same selected W/D/S dimensions, assembly IDs and quantities, and material assignments: 18 mm birch plywood with clear water-based lacquer for tabletop and storage panels, and powder-coated steel tube for supports.
The materials and connections sheet shows operation, support and retention for the transformation and relocation joints, repeating the specification's M6 bolt quantity and 4 mm hex key.
